title: EBC RG CMI Level 5 Award in Professional Coaching Practice - Developing Coaching for Managers - AWARD
description:
Elmbridge Borough Council is seeking a provider to deliver CMI Level 5 Award in Professional Coaching Practice - Developing coaching for managers.  The provider must be able to deliver the key learning in this programme on site at Elmbridge Borough Council.  The provider will be required to provide all supporting materials required to undertake this training.  
      
      The council would like the training to be provided for up to 12 people identified by Elmbridge Borough Council. However, if required the provider should be in a position to make additional places available.  
      
      The provider must ensure there are minimum number of guided learning hours as directed by the Chartered Management Institute. This should not be an e-learning course. The course must be accredited by the CMI.

title: EBC - RB - CLEANING SERVICES - AWARD
description:
Elmbridge Borough Council is initiating a Restricted Procedure tender for Cleaning Services at the Council's premises in accordance with the Public Contracts Regulations 2015. 
      Supplier(s) will be required to provide full cleaning services.
      
      The Council has approximately 16 buildings that include Elmbridge Borough Council offices & Transport Hub, Centres for the Community, a Community Hub/CAB, and Public Conveniences. 
      
      The Services have been divided into the following work packages (Lots):
      (i) Lot 1 - Civic Centre, Esher;
      (ii) Lot 2 - Six centres for the community, the Walton Community Hub/Citizens Advice Bureau, and a Transport Hub;
      (iii) Lot 3 - Eight public conveniences within the borough.  
      
      The Council proposes to enter into a Contract with the successful Bidder(s) to provide cleaning services for the above Lots for an initial 3 year term with the option to extend for a further 2 x 12 month periods (total 5 years).
      The anticipated service commencement date is 1 February 2025.
      
      In the initial Pre- qualification stage, suppliers are asked to submit a completed Standard Selection Questionnaire (SQ). A shortlist of suppliers will then be invited to submit a tender at the ITT stage.

title: B4063 Gloucester to Cheltenham (G2C) Cycleway scheme - Estcourt Road Roundabout to Elmbridge Court Roundabout September 2023
description:
This advert is intended to notify potential suppliers of the tender for B4063 Gloucester to Cheltenham (G2C) Cycleway scheme between Estcourt Road Roadabout to Elmbridge Court Roundabout, including Llanthony Road and Pirton Lane junctions. This is the same previously advertised as Project Information DN676673. The scheme has been revalued which has required it to be re-advertised at a higher value above the FTS Works Threshold.\r
\r
The site is found to the northeast of Elmbridge Court Roundabout (approx. post code GL3 1AD) with two individual junctions, Llanthony Road (approx. post code GL2 5JQ) and Pirton Lane (approx. post code GL3 1AE). This is part of a bigger scheme to address the needs of pedestrians and cyclists and create an Active Travel corridor\r
between the towns of Cheltenham and Gloucester. The overall scheme will implement a continuous cycleway for cyclists of all ages and abilities between the main hubs of Cheltenham and Gloucester, utilising London Road, Cheltenham Road, B4063, and part of the A40 between Arle Court roundabout and Benhall roundabout.\r
\r
This contract is looking for a Principal Contractor to deliver the construction phase of Estcourt Road Roundabout to Elmbridge Court Roundabout, including Llanthony Road and Pirton Lane junctions. A more detailed summary of the works is included below:\r

title: SCC Building Belonging Programme
description:
SCC have received funding from NHSE (NHS England) from within their 'The Framework for Integrated Care NHS Improvement Long Term Plan' which is committed to provide additional support for the most vulnerable children and young people with complex needs across multiple domains between the ages of 0 to 18. 

SCC will use the funding received to test and pilot a service model.
The pilot in Elmbridge will bring together a multi-diverse team from a range of SCC, SABP and Third Sector providers who will come together all offering a range of different support available for children and their families but who will all be working together effectively with a 1 team approach under the umbrella of the Building Belonging Programme. We will be working from the agreed NHS England 'Framework for Integrated Care (Community) 
Vanguard Specification'

The families who we anticipate this programme would support are often regarded as not meeting the criteria for existing Level 2/Level 3 current provision as either having too complex needs or not yet meeting the threshold.   

The requirements cover services falling within Schedule 3 of the PCR's and are therefore subject to the Light Touch Regime contained within Chapter 3, Section 7 of PCR 2015 (Regulations 74 to 77).
